verdict.rationale: Stripe's Radar docs say it evaluates transactions, accounts, and customers in real time using AI algorithms to assess fraud risk, which covers the ML screening half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows custom block, review, or allow rules, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented custom block/review/allow rule authoring, exposure of per-transaction risk scores to finance-ops users, a manual review queue workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
